info.title: Wasmou API
info.description: Sell digital goods: catalog, purchase, delivery, game top-ups and per-client stock. All amounts are in DZD.

ApiKey.name: X-Api-Key
ApiKey.description: Your API key from the Wasmou app (API access).

available_balance.description: What you can spend right now.

remaining.description: Units you can buy right now. null when released (unrestricted).

in_stock.description: Units left for key-based variants; null for instant and topup.

async.description: True when the product is activated on the customer account after the order (subscriptions): the order stays `processing` for a while.

warranty.description: Warranty of the variant, or null.

input_fields.description: Extra inputs to send with the purchase when requires_input is true. Send each value in the purchase body under its `index` as the key.

kind.description: How the product is fulfilled. Top-up kinds send the credit to the player or Telegram username given in the inputs.

guide.description: Activation steps for the customer, in the language of `lang`.

get.description: Health of the gateway. No API key needed.
Check what you can spend before ordering.
Every active product and variant with your price, delivery mode and stock, in one response. Safe to refresh every few minutes.
Products with their variants (lighter than the catalog: no delivery mode or stock counts).

post.description: Buys `quantity` units of a variant. Your wallet is debited and, for allocated variants, your stock is consumed, in one transaction. Returns the order IDs; fetch the code with the retrieve endpoint. Include any `input_fields` listed in the catalog.

422.description: Not enough allocated stock for your account

400.description: Validation error, out of stock or unavailable

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique value (8 to 128 characters) for this purchase. Retrying the same request with the same key returns the original answer (header `Idempotent-Replay: true`) and never charges twice. Reusing a key with a different body returns 422. Keys are remembered for 24 hours.

key_id.description: Optional. A specific key to buy; if omitted one is assigned for you.

schema.description: Plus any product-specific input fields (for example player_id).

get.description: Status and delivered code of one order.

post.description: Status and codes for up to many orders in one call. Use this to poll.

get.description: Every order on your account (gift cards, game top-ups and keys), newest first.
Your allocation for one variant. If you have none, `restricted` is `false`.

post.description: Checks a game player ID with the supplier before you order a top-up. Send the inputs keyed by their `index` (see `input_fields` in the catalog). Only products with `kind` `topup` are supported.

Lists the VIP Server (sports and live TV) subscriptions found on a device serial and the packages you can activate, at your price. Order a package with `POST /products/purchase/{variantId}` using the returned `variant_id` and the serial under input index `0`. Packages are only valid for this serial: check again before each order.

serial.description: Device serial, 4 to 40 letters, digits, - or _

get.description: Operators, supported top-up types, limits and your discount in percent. Read it instead of hard-coding limits.

post.description: Real-time offers for one number (5 to 15 seconds). Offers are number-specific: do not cache them across numbers.
Required before `prepaid` and `offer` top-ups to an Ooredoo number. Valid for about 9 minutes.

Debits your wallet and answers `202`. The top-up is sent in the background: poll `GET /flexy/status/{id}` until `final` is true. A failed top-up is refunded automatically. Send `idempotency_key` so a retry never charges twice.

pay_debt.description: Ooredoo only: pay the unpaid balance with this top-up

expected_price.description: Optional: refuse the order if your price changed

post.description: Checks the whole list, then processes it in the background, line by line. Each line is a normal Flexy order with its own refund. Poll `GET /flexy/bulk/{id}` until `final` is true. Use `dry_run` to price a list without charging.

422.description: No valid line, or validation error
